title: EXISTING FINGER BONES → STANDARD MAP + HAND MOTION (P1)
specNature: PROPOSAL ONLY — Human Spec PASS not declared; implementation DENY until APPROVED
purpose: For Meshy-style rigged+skinned GLBs that already have finger bones, diagnose adaptability, map to NURION hand standard, optionally repair axes/names, and add a minimal hand-motion clip set while preserving BODY/Skin and sealed FACE/TALKING contracts.
coreClaim: Existing finger-bone characters can receive NURION standard hand mapping + min motion library without mutating source bytes and without reopening Engine V2.
passMeans: Human Spec APPROVED → prototype stages P01–P08 PASS under independent gates → Human Final on proof package. Only then CLI --add-hand-rig may claim HAND_RIG_PASS / HAND_MOTION_PASS / NEUTRAL_RETURN_PASS together with existing FACE/TALKING consume PASS.
passDoesNotMean: weight synthesis from scratch for bone-less hands
full gesture emotion library beyond min set
